name: The Dragon Scar Expedition
description: Investigate reports of dragon activity in the northern wastes

stages.name: Investigate Tracks
stages.description: Scout the reported dragon tracks near the border

stages.name: Clear the Raiders
stages.description: Raiders have established a camp near the dragon's territory. Drive them out.

stages.name: Reach the Scarred Site
stages.description: Travel to the location where the dragon was last sighted.

stages.name: The First Encounter
stages.description: A young drake blocks your path. You must drive it off without killing it — this is not a hunt, it is a survival test.
